description: End-to-end model-organism workflow. Cost formulas are bookkeeping and source-informed design judgments, not source-reported GPU-hour benchmarks or current price quotes.
price_units: Token prices in formulas are USD per token; divide per-million-token quotes by 1,000,000. Hourly rates are USD per hour.
no_double_counting: Use either hardware rental or provider charges for the same compute, and count validation reruns once. A grader's construction cost, if newly trained, is additional; pretrained judges are assumed here.
scope: Existing 7–8B open-weight base; pretraining excluded. Training/label choices and evaluation/grader choices are independent. Full SFT, adapter training, and algebraic editing are different construction routes.

components.work: Download, storage, loading, memory and serving
components.cost_expression: Storage and hosting charges + setup time
components.supervision_or_scope: No new annotation; no new base-model pretraining assumed

components.work: Curate examples; author task instances and answer keys
components.cost_expression: Curation hours + authoring hours + script runtime
components.supervision_or_scope: Existing labels or generated answer keys; public data may contain prior human supervision

components.work: Generate targets, revisions, or preference labels
components.supervision_or_scope: Can avoid new human training labels; output quality still needs checking
Human input to the construction data; distinct from evaluation ratings

components.work: Forward/backward passes and optimizer updates for all weights
components.cost_expression: Training GPU_hours * rental_rate OR metered training-token bill
components.supervision_or_scope: Target responses; synthetic supervision is possible

components.work: Forward/backward passes; adapter gradients and optimizer state
components.cost_expression: Training GPU_hours * rental_rate OR metered training-token bill
components.supervision_or_scope: Target responses; small trainable state does not mean no backpropagation

components.work: Backpropagate through a quantized frozen base into adapters
components.cost_expression: Training GPU_hours * rental_rate OR metered training-token bill
components.supervision_or_scope: Quantized base saves memory; wall-time savings are not guaranteed

components.work: Contrast forward passes, vector selection/validation, and algebraic weight editing
components.cost_expression: Extraction inference + development validation inference + weight-edit work
components.supervision_or_scope: Contrast prompt sets; harmful target completions and gradient training are not required

components.work: Specify context or use existing model/adapter weights
components.supervision_or_scope: Previous training is a sunk cost; additional prompt tokens recur at inference

components.work: Generate outputs for base, organism, interventions, and controls
components.cost_expression: Sum input/output token charges across N answers OR actual inference GPU-hours
components.supervision_or_scope: N = prompts * conditions * repeats; answer lengths can differ across conditions

components.work: Compare answer keys, run tests, or inspect specified actions
components.supervision_or_scope: No labeller needed for exact outcomes; validates only the specified property

components.work: Send rubric, task, answer and context to one or more judge models
components.cost_expression: Sum judge input_tokens * input_price + verdict_tokens * output_price across scoring passes
components.supervision_or_scope: Automated judgments can be biased; validation is task-specific

components.work: Rate outputs, supply comparison labels, or audit a stratified subset
components.supervision_or_scope: Optional grading/calibration route; this is separate from human training labels

components.work: Test interpretation and robustness; estimate uncertainty
components.cost_expression: Analysis CPU/researcher time + extra evaluation and scoring, counted once
components.supervision_or_scope: No required universal seed or sample count; narrow claims can use narrower validation

benchmark_examples.name: MT-Bench
benchmark_examples.scope: Multi-turn dialogue quality assessed by LLM judges

benchmark_examples.name: HarmBench
benchmark_examples.scope: Trained LLM classifiers for standard non-copyright behaviors; separate hashing-based checks for copyright behaviors

ledger.limitations: Internal historical estimates, not verified invoices. Data work, local GPU use, human labour and unlogged usage are not fully represented.
